SafeBreach Careers

Join our fast-growing global team as we fundamentally change the way the world manages its defenses and controls cyber risk.

View Open Positions

To be the best, we hire the best.

In the world of cybersecurity, it’s not enough to be smart. We have to be more innovative, more passionate, and more ambitious than the adversaries we work against. We’re building a diverse, creative team that’s doing just that—are you ready to join us?

Fulfilling Challenges


As part of a team addressing some of our customers’ most critical and complex problems, you’ll make a real impact on how the world manages the ever-changing threat landscape.

Work-Life Balance


We know employees are whole people, with families and lives outside of work. We honor that by offering remote work, non-traditional hours, and unlimited vacation for the ultimate work-life “fit.”

United Community


We strive to create a collaborative, equitable workplace that isn’t constrained by hierarchy, ego, or geographic boundaries. We’re a global team with unlimited potential—and when one of us wins, we all win.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

We know a true commitment to diversity requires a vigilant focus on listening, learning, and improving. We’re constantly working to create an environment of inclusivity and equality that empowers individuals to be their authentic selves.

Our Core Values

Customer Obsession

They are the reason for all we do

Move One Step Ahead

Relentlessly proactive

To Embrace Challenge

As one

Do It! Continuously

Keep it simple and drive progress forward

Turn Big Dreams into Reality

Make today’s constraints irrelevant

Benefits

What we do is who we are. Our benefits provide the support you need to be your best.

Competitive salary and equity grants

100% employer-paid health and dental insurance

Flexible hours and time off

Team fun and company outings

Monthly Internet and phone stipend
